notes: Discovered the site's own New Arrivals taxonomy tree via the embedded __NEXT_DATA__ breadcrumb on a leaf page: All Departments > New Arrivals (cat 15720522, /cp/new-arrivals/15720522) > New Items (cat 8131, sitewide) > New Home, Furniture, & Appliances (cat 6400170, /browse/new-home-furniture-appliances/6400170) > New in Kitchen & Dining (cat 1818, /browse/new-arrivals-kitchen-dining/1818). A matching 'New Arrivals' tile is also placed in the Featured-Categories hub-and-spoke module on BOTH /cp/home-furniture/1285 (linking to the broad 6400170 node) and /cp/housewares/1373 [Kitchen & Dining] (linking directly to the specific 1818 leaf). Checked /cp/home-decor/1358 and /cp/home-improvement/1390 [Lighting] in full - neither has its own New Arrivals tile; the homepage hero-carousel 'New Arrivals' tile also points at the broad sitewide node, not a decor-specific one. INCLUDED row: 'New in Kitchen & Dining' - qty verified as 37 by deduplicating the page's own embedded Product objects / itemStacks id-map (single page load, paginationV2.maxPage=1, so this is the complete listing, not a partial page). The site's own displayed totalItemCount=40 / gridItemsCount=39 include roughly 2-3 non-Product ad/sponsored placements - a known count-inflation pattern already documented for this site in the prior Home-Decor pass (notes/190.md, which found the same 1-item ad-slot inflation on other category pages). All 37 products are genuinely Kitchen & Dining (dinnerware, glassware, cookware, kitchen organizers, plus small kitchen appliances such as a slow cooker/multi-cooker/ice maker) - squarely within this company's established Kitchen & Dining department scope. EXCLUDED as out of Home/Furniture/Decor scope: the parent 'New Home, Furniture, & Appliances' node (cat 6400170, own totalItemCount=270, stable across its page load). Inspected a 46-product title sample from its first page plus its own 'Product Type' facet (107 distinct values covering the listing): dominated by Outdoor Decor (28), Throws (16), Comforters (14), Live Plants (11), Wreaths (11), Christmas Trees (8) - textile/seasonal-holiday items that belong to other sibling category projects per the prior pass's own exclusion precedent - plus kitchen small-appliances (Air Fryers, Slow Cookers, Robot Vacuum & Mop), Automotive Detailing Accessories, and Garden Hoses/Pressure Washers, which are not decor-relevant at all. Genuine Furniture/Decor-proper items are only a thin scatter within this bucket (Mirrors:2, Bar & Counter Stools:1, Bed Frames:1, Coffee Tables:1, Gaming Chairs:1, Ceiling Fans:1) with no site-side filter able to isolate a Home/Furniture/Decor-only subset at an exact count, so per the task's scope-to-decor instruction this broad mixed-department node is excluded rather than guessed at or padded. No other New-Arrivals-style concept (Just In, Latest, What's New, Recently Added) was found anywhere on the site beyond this one taxonomy branch.
